title: How to Introduce yourself in English -- FOR BEGINNERS!

header.titleZh: 如何用英文介紹自己－適合初學者！
header.titleEn: How to Introduce yourself in English -- FOR BEGINNERS!

sentences.en: Welcome to my Slow English podcast. Take your time. Listen carefully and watch my hand gestures to understand new words in English.
sentences.tc: 歡迎來到我的慢速英語podcast。慢慢來。仔細聽並觀察我的手勢來理解英文生詞。

sentences.en: Today I want to introduce myself to you.
sentences.tc: 今天我想向你們介紹我自己。

sentences.en: I am Tyiana. My full name is Tyiana Ortiz. My.
sentences.tc: 我是蒂亞娜。我的全名是蒂亞娜·奧爾蒂斯。我的。

sentences.en: First name is Tyiana and my last name is Ortiz.
sentences.tc: 我的名字是蒂亞娜，我的姓氏是奧提斯。

sentences.en: I am 21 years old. Actually, I will be 22 years old.
sentences.tc: 我今年21歲。事實上，我今年就22歲了。

sentences.en: Next week. My birthday is November 22nd. So I will be turning 22 on November 22nd.
sentences.tc: 下週。我的生日是11月22日。所以我將於 11 月 22 日滿 22 歲。

sentences.en: I will be turning 22 years old. And in the United States, that is called your golden birthday.
sentences.tc: 我馬上就22歲了。在美國，這被稱為你的黃金生日。

sentences.en: If you were born on January 4th and you turn 4 years old,.
sentences.tc: 如果你出生於1月4日並且你滿4歲了。

tags.note: 看到 birthday 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 old 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 years 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: Then that's your golden birthday.
sentences.tc: 那就是你的黃金生日。

sentences.en: Tell me when is your golden birthday? Did your golden birthday already pass or not yet?
sentences.tc: 告訴我你的黃金生日是什麼時候？你的黃金生日已經過去了嗎？

sentences.en: I am from the United States, Nebraska. I was born in Nebraska, USA. I grew up in Nebraska, USA. My mom is from the United States. My dad is from Mexico.
sentences.tc: 我來自美國內布拉斯加州。我出生在美國內布拉斯加州。我在美國內布拉斯加州長大。我媽媽來自美國。我爸爸來自墨西哥。

sentences.en: That's why I look kind of mixed like a cappuccino. When I was 8 years old, my dad was deported back to Mexico.
sentences.tc: 這就是為什麼我看起來有點像卡布奇諾。當我8歲時，我父親被驅逐回墨西哥。

sentences.en: We all moved to Mexico to live.
sentences.tc: 我們都搬到墨西哥居住。

sentences.en: It was a big change. Everything changed. But Mexico has beautiful people.
sentences.tc: 這是一個很大的改變。一切都變了。但墨西哥有美麗的人民。

sentences.en: Are you from? Where did you grow up? I studied elementary school, middle school, and high school in Mexico. But I did not study at university. Did you study at university?
sentences.tc: 你是來自嗎？你在哪裡長大？我在墨西哥讀了小學、國中和高中。但我沒有讀過大學。你讀過大學嗎？

sentences.en: What did you study? After high school, I began to work to make money. I worked as an English teacher online. That was my job?
sentences.tc: 你學了什麼？高中畢業後，我開始打工賺錢。我在網路上擔任英語老師。那是我的工作嗎？

tags.note: 看到 job 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 mexico 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 school 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I work at my job. I worked as an English teacher. I worked at Craving English, Preply, Open English, and Out School.
sentences.tc: 我做我的工作。我擔任英語老師。我曾在 Craving English、Preply、Open English 和 Out School 工作過。

sentences.en: I had so many jobs.
sentences.tc: 我有很多工作。

sentences.en: I love working as an English teacher.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡英語老師的工作。

sentences.en: It is a really fun job. I talk to interesting people. I help them learn and understand English.
sentences.tc: 這是一項非常有趣的工作。我和有趣的人交談。 I help them learn and understand English.

sentences.en: They practice English with me.
sentences.tc: 他們和我一起練習英語。

sentences.en: I love teaching.
sentences.tc: 我熱愛教學。

sentences.en: What is your job?
sentences.tc: 你做什麼工作？

sentences.en: What do you do for work? Remember, job is a noun. Work is a verb. I speak English and Spanish?
sentences.tc: 你做什麼工作？請記住，工作是一個名詞。工作是一個動詞。我會說英語和西班牙語？
